summary: A taut, visual beat with a clean dramatic turn: apparent targets arrive, Shalabi recognizes the trap, and discipline defeats impulse. The dialogue is concise, period-credible, and playable under concealment.

performance.delivery: Count each vehicle while keeping his face down beside Shalabi. The report is precise and barely voiced, timed through the engine noise.

lines.speaker: SHALABI

performance.delivery: Keep his eyes on the vehicles and his palm pressed flat as a physical order to hold. The realization tightens his voice, but the command remains clipped and completely controlled.

lines.text: دُولْ طُعْمْ… لَوْ ضَرَبْنَاهُمْ، الطَّيَرَانْ هَيِنْزِلْ عَلِينَا. بَلَّغْ: مَحَدِّشْ يِتْحَرَّكْ.
